name: Sessions
description: Search raw prior conversation turns for supporting evidence.
progressive_guidance: Start with concrete concepts from the owner request or memory results. When a result reveals a candidate entity, search again with alternative wording for the relationship being verified. Prefer owner-authored matches for claims about the owner; research or interest alone does not prove ownership or preference.

searchSessions.description: Search visible messages across prior sessions. Returns the best match per session with nearby turns for evidence and provenance.

query.description: Concrete names, phrases, or concepts likely to appear in the prior conversation. Refine a discovered entity with alternative wording for the relationship being verified.

role.description: Whose messages may be direct matches. Use owner for personal facts; surrounding context still includes both roles.

topK.description: Maximum number of distinct sessions to return, from 1 to 10.

contextWindow.description: Nearby visible turns to return on each side, from 0 to 6.

includeCurrentSession.description: Also search the current session. Defaults to false because the current transcript is already available.
